Realbotix opens Echo reservations with pricing and a 250-unit first run

Tabletop costs $11,950 and Full Body $59,950, with a required monthly subscription; the $199 reservation is not the robot price.

Realbotix ↗26 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Reservations, prices and production plans

Realbotix launched Echo for conversation, education and wellness applications. The first run is planned as 225 Tabletop and 25 Full Body units, for delivery in the second half of 2027. Prices are $11,950 and $59,950 respectively; the $199 reservation deposit is not the purchase price.

Motion and continuing service costs

Tabletop has 17 degrees of freedom and Full Body 39. Realbotix describes silicone skin, expressive faces and support for over 100 languages. Operation and management require an app subscription starting at $19.99 per month. Vinci adds optional on-device vision and AI.

Claims, privacy and remaining milestones

The release proposes social and wellness applications without clinical outcome evidence. Local processing is an option, but necessary content may go to external providers when cloud AI or speech features are used. Delivery timing and future features remain company plans rather than evidence of immediate availability.
